newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells 182-day BBCs at 2.37 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells 182-day BBCs at 2.37 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 451 million reais of 182-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) Tuesday at an overnight rate of 2.37 percent a month, dealers said.
It was the first time the Central Bank sold 182-day BBC bonds since May 13 and the result of the auction was in line with market expectations, dealers added.
The Central Bank also sold 1.942 billion reais in 56-day BBCs at an overnight rate of 2.195 percent a month, down from 2.238 percent last week.
The financial result of the auction indicated 107 million reais will be added to the banking system as 2.5 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
